item.title: What Changed on February 20th?
item.description: On February 17, 2026, the FBI detected a breach of its Digital Collection System Network — the internal system used to manage wiretapping and foreign intelligence surveillance warrants. According to a notification sent to Congress and reviewed by the Associated Press, the breached system contained pen register and trap-and-trace surveillance returns, and personally identifiable information pertaining to subjects of FBI investigations. The attacker’s techniques were described as sophisticated. The breach was not publicly disclosed until March 3-5.
